_meta.note: cost = clicks/taps/chords from the app's start screen; 'affordance' = read from a one-step control without triggering it (it would write into the owner's data)

records.pattern: left ribbon of actions + side pane with tabs + editor tabs + command palette

J8.how: Ctrl+O quick switcher, or the Search tab

J10.how: gear at the side pane's foot

records.notes: Everything is one step: actions live on the ribbon and in the command palette rather than in destinations; no notion of 'screens' beyond notes, canvases and bases.

records.pattern: left sidebar: global actions (Add task, Search) above fixed views (Inbox, Today, Upcoming, Filters & Labels, Reporting) above user projects; account menu holds settings

J1.how: Add task (Q from anywhere); natural-language dates typed in the same line

J6.how: Upcoming (week strip); recurrence typed in natural language in the task line ('every day')

J9.how: Reporting (sidebar); also in the account menu

J10.how: account menu, Settings (or the sequence O then S)

records.notes: Every account-menu entry carries a two-key sequence (G then A, O then S, O then P). Natural-language entry is the J1/J6 mechanism.

records.account: owner's own (geometry only; no page names recorded)
records.pattern: left sidebar: workspace + Inbox + New page; 'Search or ask' (Ctrl+K); fixed tabs Home / Chat / Meetings; then user sections Favorites, Shared, Private (the page tree); workspace menu at the foot

jobs.J2: n/a (Home only lists recent pages unless a calendar is connected)

J7.how: New page; no built-in journal (a template or a database)

records.notes: Navigation is the user's own page tree under three fixed sections; the fixed part is small (3 tabs). The tree is the destination list.

records.pattern: single list screen; bottom app bar (menu, search, sort, more) + FAB; navigation drawer as a bottom sheet holding lists and filters; settings in the top overflow

J6.how: FAB, then the repeat field; no week view

records.notes: Lists and filters are destinations inside a drawer, not a bar: one fixed screen whose content the drawer swaps.

records.pattern: one list of habits with the last days as tick columns; toolbar actions (Add, Filter, More); a habit opens its own detail with charts

toolbar: More: Night mode, Settings, Help, About

J2.how: the start screen is today's habits

J4.how: today's tick box on the habit row

J9.how: tap a habit: score, history, charts

records.notes: No navigation structure at all: the job is the start screen, logging is in place, review is one tap into the item. Shows a score (%) on detail, which Factotum's Habits must not (no streaks, 0.1.3).

records.account: none (fresh install; ad ID declined; free tier, no trial)
records.pattern: bottom bar of 4 destinations split by a centre + (new entry); month header with search; premium upsell banner

J5.how: centre +, then the mood row (first run lands on it with 0)

J7.how: + then 'Open the full note' (a note belongs to an entry)

records.notes: The check-in is the centre action of the bar, one tap from every destination. Achievement popups and a paywall after the first entry: engagement framing Factotum avoids (purpose-integrity check).

records.account: none (new local vault 'Survey', app storage, sync skipped)
records.pattern: top bar (sidebar toggle, tab title, more) + bottom toolbar (back, forward, search, new, tabs, menu); the menu is the desktop ribbon as a list; sidebar holds files/search/bookmarks and settings
records.notes: Phone and desktop share one model: the desktop ribbon becomes a bottom-toolbar menu, the side pane becomes a slide-in sidebar. Toolbar is persistent on every screen, so every job keeps the same cost from anywhere.

records.account: owner's own install (controls only, no event text read)
records.pattern: one screen in a chosen view (month by default); top actions Search, Change view, Filter by calendar, More; FAB New event; no bottom bar

J2.how: Change view, then day or list (month is the start)

J6.how: Change view, Week; repeat in the event editor (FAB, then Repeat)

records.notes: Views of one dataset are a switch on one screen, not destinations.

records.account: none (fresh install; data on device; setup skipped; terms accepted per owner 2026-10-05)
records.pattern: bottom bar of 4 icons (Check in, Calendar, Friends, Tools); the start screen is the check-in prompt with one + and a week strip

J7.how: + then the note step of the check-in

J10.how: no settings control on the three tabs visited; not found

records.notes: The app opens on the one question it exists for; the bar carries only four peers. Friends is a social-peer surface Factotum has no use for.

records.pattern: bottom bar of 4 (Inbox, Today, Upcoming, Browse) + Quick add FAB on every bar destination; Browse is the hub for Search, Filters & Labels, projects, settings

J6.how: Upcoming (week strip); recurrence typed in the quick-add line

jobs.J9: n/a on phone (reporting not in the bar)

records.notes: Desktop's sidebar becomes 3 time views + a Browse hub on the phone; search drops from 1 step (desktop) to 2. A Pro upsell sheet on first Browse.

records.pattern: bottom bar of 4 unlabelled icons by module (Tasks, Calendar, Habits, Settings/profile) + FAB on Tasks; a drawer on Tasks holds the list views (Today, Inbox, custom) with search, notifications and settings in its header

J4.how: drawer, Today, checkbox (1 if the start list holds it)

records.notes: The all-in-one shape: modules are bar tabs (tasks, calendar, habits), each with its own inner navigation; Today is two taps deep inside Tasks. Icons carry no labels.

records.pattern: bottom bar of 5 labelled tabs (Home, Impacts, Trends, Reports, Bear); Home is today: week strip + a stack of tracking cards (Mood, Sleep, Gratitude, ...) + 'Mark day complete'; settings gear and the day picker in Home's header

J4.how: a card on Home (sleep, symptoms, habits)

J9.how: Trends or Reports or Impacts (three look-back tabs)

J10.how: gear in Home's header (2 from another tab)

records.notes: Today-first composite for tracking: every daily input is a card on one Home, and three of five tabs are look-back. 'What helps my mood' (Bear tab) is the regulation analogue. Gamified bear profile.

records.pattern: start = list of spaces ('Channels') with profile, + and a Quick capture FAB; a space opens on its home object; inside, a bottom bar of Search, Discussion, Create object
records.notes: Object-graph app: no fixed destinations below the space; search and create are the navigation.

records.pattern: slim icon rail of modules with Ctrl+1..4 (Task, Calendar, Pomodoro, Habit Tracker) + Search (Ctrl+F); Task module has a list sidebar (Today, Next 7 Days, Inbox, Lists, Tags, Filters, Completed, Trash); avatar menu holds settings

J1.how: 'Add Task' line at the top of every list

records.notes: Same modules as the phone's bar, plus Pomodoro and Search on the rail; Settings leaves the rail for the avatar. Modules have numeric hotkeys, as Tendril has.

records.account: owner's placeholder account; onboarding filled with neutral placeholders
records.pattern: left sidebar of places (Home, Today, Focus) and RITUALS (Daily planning, Daily shutdown, Daily highlights; Weekly planning, Weekly review) + Backlog; centre = days as columns; right = a calendar panel and a rail of panel toggles (icons without tooltips: calendar, search, AI, add, others)

J1.how: '+ Add task' at the top of a day column

J6.how: Daily planning or Weekly planning (a guided ritual), or Home's day columns

J8.how: search icon in the right rail

records.notes: Navigation by cadence: the sidebar names rituals by when they happen (daily, weekly) rather than by module. Planning and review are guided step sequences (add, estimate, fit, prioritise, schedule, document) - the closest reference to a planner that confirms a week (Factotum §3.6b).

records.pattern: left sidebar per space: space header with Search and New object; pinned objects as widgets; a 'Types' section listing object types (Pages, Tasks, Collections, Bookmarks, Images); top bar back/forward, history, graph

sidebar: Types: Pages, Tasks, Collections, Bookmarks, Images

J4.how: Types: Tasks, then the task's checkbox

records.notes: Navigation by TYPE: the sidebar lists kinds of object (pages, tasks, collections), a model that maps onto Factotum's item kinds. Phone hides the type list behind the space; desktop shows it.

records.pattern: opens on TODAY'S JOURNAL page; a collapsible left sidebar: graph switcher, Navigation (Journals, Flashcards, All pages, Graph view), Favorites, Recent; search icon top-left; right sidebar toggle top-right

J1.how: type on today's journal page (the start screen)

jobs.J2: n/a (tasks are blocks; queries list them)

J4.how: a TODO block's checkbox in the journal

J7.how: the start screen IS today's journal

records.notes: Journal-first: the daily page is the home and the capture surface; everything else is reached from the sidebar or search. Sidebar collapses away, leaving only the day.

records.pattern: classic three panes: sidebar (Notebooks: All notes, notebooks, Trash; Tags; Sync button) | note list (search field, New note, New to-do) | editor with a split preview; full menu bar (File, Edit, View, Go, Note, Tools, Help)

J4.how: a to-do's checkbox in the note list

J8.how: search field above the note list

records.notes: The densest and oldest pattern: everything visible at once, no destinations to switch between; the menu bar holds the rest.
